# United Nations Development Programme

> > UNDP eradicates poverty and reduces inequalities across 170+ countries through sustainable development, climate action, and governance initiatives aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals and Paris Agreement.

UNDP is a global development organization operating country offices across Africa, Asia, Latin America, and the Caribbean, with thematic hubs addressing energy transition, resilience, and strategic foresight. The organization publishes research, country programs, and policy analysis in multiple languages including English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Agenda 2030
- Climate Action
- Poverty Reduction
- Governance and Peace
- African Debt Sustainability
- Renewable Energy Transition
- Digital Transformation
- Gender Equality
- Resilience Building
- China-Africa Partnership
- Blue Economy
- Diaspora Investment
- Human Development
- Economic Growth

## Global Strategy & Vision

- [Home](https://www.undp.org): UNDP homepage: eradicating poverty and reducing inequalities in 170+ countries and territories
- [Future of Development](https://www.undp.org/future-development): UNDP Strategic Plan 2026-2029 outlining future development vision and participatory foresight

## Thematic Hubs & Initiatives

- [Sustainable Energy Hub](https://www.undp.org/energy): UNDP Sustainable Energy Hub advancing renewable energy transition aligned with Paris Agreement
- [UNDP Resilience Hub for Africa](https://www.undp.org/africa/resilience-hub-africa): UNDP Resilience Hub for Africa partnering with African Union on digital transformation and recovery

## Country Offices & Regional Programs

- [Kenya](https://www.undp.org/kenya): UNDP Kenya country office advancing sustainable development and digital AI skilling in Nairobi
- [Turkmenistan](https://www.undp.org/tk/turkmenistan): UNDP Turkmenistan country office supporting climate adaptation, youth innovation, and healthcare
- [Liberia](https://www.undp.org/liberia): UNDP Liberia advancing climate resilience, gender empowerment, and sustainable coastal development
- [São Tomé e Príncipe](https://www.undp.org/pt/sao-tome-principe): UNDP São Tomé e Príncipe country office promoting governance, climate action, and civil society
- [Guinea-Bissau](https://www.undp.org/pt/guinea-bissau): UNDP Guinea-Bissau supporting sustainable development, blue economy, and green recovery
- [Geneva](https://www.undp.org/geneva): UNDP Geneva office coordinating partnerships on sustainable development and human rights

## Research & Analysis

- [Ending Poverty by Reducing Unsustainable Debt in Africa](https://www.undp.org/fr/blog/mettre-fin-la-pauvrete-en-diminuant-le-poids-insoutenable-de-la-dette-en-afrique): Angela Lusigi examines African debt sustainability and poverty reduction through China-Africa partnership
- [5 Challenges for Latin America and the Caribbean in Agenda 2030](https://www.undp.org/es/blog/5-retos-de-america-latina-y-el-caribe-en-la-agenda-2030): Analysis of Agenda 2030 implementation challenges for Latin America and Caribbean development
- [An Ounce of Democracy](https://www.undp.org/blog/ounce-democracy): Abdoulaye Mar Dieye on conflict prevention through democratic institutions and resilience building

## Innovation & Special Initiatives

- [Adopting a Cedar Tree Brings Diaspora Money Home](https://www.undp.org/blog/adopting-cedar-tree-brings-diaspora-money-home): UNDP Innovation Facility explores blockchain and cryptocurrency for diaspora investment in Lebanon
- [COVID-19 Lessons to Strengthen Gender-Based Violence Prevention](https://www.undp.org/es/blog/como-las-lecciones-de-la-covid-19-pueden-fortalecer-los-esfuerzos-para-prevenir-la-violencia-de-genero): COVID-19 lessons applied to strengthen gender-based violence prevention and women's equality
